author: catalog_audit
generation_method: Independent AI author uses the existing 32-capability definitions and legacy scenarios. Each of 160 semantic families has two natural Chinese paraphrases with identical labels. All facts deciding labels are in text; there is no hidden context.
blinding_method: Before final model lock root receives only aggregate counts, IDs, hashes and issue types. Test text, individual gold and predictions are not sent to development authors.
review_method: Author self-review plus full independent AI review of all 320 test rows and every revision. New v4 training is checked at finite atom/template level separately; no per-row human training review is implied.

independent_review.method: Full independent AI reading of every reserved sentence and its gold, all 160 family pairs, full prohibition boundaries, all four statuses and ambiguity types; all author revisions reread. Frozen bytes differ from the approved semantic version only in cross_review metadata.

exact_duplicate_screen.method: All reserved text compared with itself, all 2900 v2/v3 rows, all current v4 train/validation rows, and 163 historical phrases.

token_length_check.method: Actual unchanged WordPiece.ets executed with real paired vocabularies on host Node; no model inference

freeze_policy.blinding: Procedural separation in the shared workspace; only independent test author and independent reviewer inspect reserved prompts and individual labels before model lock.

semantic_leakage_screen: Reviewed concrete legacy/current scenarios and rewrote confirmed same-template reuse only in reserved data. Shared capability vocabulary alone is not treated as leakage. Exact/family isolation and AI review do not prove human-validated semantic independence.
limitations: All 320 rows remain agent-generated and human_review=pending; this frozen synthetic candidate is not a human-approved production acceptance benchmark.
The four intent classes and 32 capability labels are semantic targets. Existing catalog platform conditions remain; this task adds no SDK or phone validation.
The duplicate screen and independent AI review cannot establish unrestricted real-world semantic generalization or absence of all historical influence.
Real vocabulary length checks establish token fit only; no model accuracy, calibration or runtime behavior was measured by the author.
